discovery.description: Check, build and publish complete TypeBox Task Bundles.
discovery.usage: pguide task-bundle check author <task.build.yaml> | check artifact <directory> | build <task.build.yaml> | publish <directory> [--ipfs-rpc <url>]

sections.title: Commands
lines: check author <file>     Compile trusted author input in memory; no output writes or network publishing.
check artifact <dir>    Validate exact manifest, Schema and UnixFS CID; never evaluate author code.
build <file>            Replace only managed output after complete validation; no network publishing.
publish <dir>           Import and pin an already built artifact; never build or execute Tasks.

sections.title: Configuration
lines: --ipfs-rpc overrides task-bundle.ipfsRpc from pguide user -> nearest project config.jsonc.
No default node, daemon startup or global configuration writes. Only publish uses RPC.

sections.title: Trust
lines: Author check/build evaluate the contract module as trusted local code, not in a sandbox.
include is a build rule, not a subcommand. Old bundles without an exact manifest must be rebuilt.
